Unknown evidence is assessed as unknown, not marked unassessed.

material_findings.title: Incorrect narrowing of captured Mirador advertised support

material_findings.title: Canvas-only identity contract lacks local/direct-service normalization

primary_evidence.applicability: Image-service info.json provides image identity/size, not a Presentation Manifest/Canvas.
Canvas frame and HTTP(S) identity are separate Presentation resources.

material_findings.materiality: Required original source types are retained verbally but cannot satisfy the new mandatory persistent Canvas fields/targets without an unspecified normalization/identity policy. This is a plan-completeness gap, not an observed runtime failure.

limitations.text: Flash-family identity and operational independence are unknown from admitted scientific files; no outside orchestration/history read.
Fresh GitHub annotated-tag API requests denied 403; frozen chain, fresh release linked commit, tagged/full-SHA equal bytes and pinned package version corroborate source/version.
Chronology, candidate operation execution, queue/setup and budget compliance cannot be authenticated from admitted authored reports alone.
No app build, usability, browser, performance, interoperability or own code execution; seven witness groups unexecuted.
Optional discovery bounded to twelve recorded mechanisms/leads; no exhaustive recall or universe of opportunity claims.

Caller-specific flip/current-position handling, aspect-ratio/framing preservation, integer selector precision and legacy rights alias mapping require explicit implementation fixtures; existing broad geometry/parser proposals are not results.

original_obligation_compliance.note: O2/O3 supported with limits; O1/O4/O6 have material evidence/completeness limits; O5 substantive review present but family provenance unknown and M1 criticism disposition affected. Counts describe requirement disposition, distinct from inventory completeness.
